LEIKKI
A screen saver, made for you.

Aalto's stools, tables and glass, drawn in single lines, tumbling
gently around your screen. Leikki is Finnish for play.


INSTALL (about a minute)

1. Double-click "Install Leikki.command".

2. macOS will probably stop it the first time, with a message that it
   "can't be opened" because it's from an unidentified developer. That's
   expected: it's a handmade gift, not something from the App Store.
   Click Done, then:

     System Settings  >  Privacy & Security
     scroll down to "Security", click "Open Anyway" next to
     "Install Leikki.command", and confirm.

   A Terminal window opens, installs Leikki, and opens Screen Saver
   settings for you.

3. In Screen Saver settings, choose Leikki (under "Other").
   Click "Options..." to choose:
     Objects: stools, tables and the tea trolley, or vases
     Text:    a small poster with world clocks, or "play"

   Then set when it starts under Lock Screen settings, if you like.


UPDATES

Leikki keeps itself up to date: once a day it quietly checks for a new
version and installs it. macOS may show a one-time note that an item was
added that can run in the background; that's the updater.


IF YOU'D RATHER USE TERMINAL

Instead of step 1 and 2, paste this into Terminal and press Return:

  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ei-kyuu/leikki/main/dist/install.sh | bash


TO REMOVE IT

Double-click "Uninstall Leikki.command" (approve it the same way as the
installer the first time). That removes the screen saver and the updater.


Needs macOS 13 Ventura or later. Works on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Furniture after Alvar Aalto (Artek); vases after the iittala Aalto
collection. An unofficial, handmade tribute.
